notes.title: Endless & Sandbox Mode Update - Operation: Polygon Storm
notes.content:
[h3][b]All aboard, Commanders![/b][/h3]
Your orders have arrived—our [b]FREE update[/b] for [b]Operation: Polygon Storm[/b] is live and ready for deployment! This update arms you with new tools and challenges to sharpen your battlefield tactics. 

Here’s what’s rolling out:

[h3][b]ENDLESS MODE ╾━╤デ╦︻[/b][/h3]
Test your endurance, as the waves of enemies never stop!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43623914/165183ace351a49c7ec98c97d1ecdbcc9908ec4a.gif[/img]

[hr]
[/hr]
[h3][b]SANDBOX MODE ╾━╤デ╦︻[/b][/h3]
The battlefield is yours to command. Control every detail and experiment!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43623914/9b1fe2ae20aa43113119111947fccc366de148bc.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43623914/b8320fcf13f006c689f3a0ca19dbcd72b7fdf43c.png[/img]

[/hr]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43623914/c8aab375dc496f40f5bee4ef03739ad737d4d7e0.gif[/img]
[hr] 
[/hr]
[h3][b] NEW UNITS  ╾━╤デ╦︻ [/b][/h3]
[b]A Minigunner specializing in rapid-fire and high volumes of firepower. A Grenade Launcher soldier dealing damage from longer distances. And a Flame Trooper simply burning everything around![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43623914/99010480f809b196061004f0fa8ccc628bb4acb4.gif[/img]
[hr] 
[/hr]
[h3][b] NEW SKINS ╾━╤デ╦︻ [/b][/h3]
[b]Soldiers want to look cool too, ok?[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43623914/8be72b9f28e484ec859698357ad76e7f0dd89e59.gif[/img]
[hr] 
[/hr]

[h3][b]Get The Train DLC NOW[/b] to deploy your troops and see how they handle the shifting terrain and intense battles that await! [/h3]

notes.title: Release date UPDATE
notes.content:
[h1][b]Good afternoon, dear community, we have a number of important announcements for you.[/b][/h1]

With great regret, we are forced to report that the release is delayed for another 1 month. Our team still consists of only 2 people and we do not want to repeat eBall mistakes. The delays are caused by the fact that the concept of the game and many mechanics have undergone cardinal changes many times (to make you understand initially we wanted to make a single player game). 

The game will be released initially in early access. We plan to regularly fill the game with new content: maps, weapons, new game mechanics. Early access will help us better prepare for a full release. The development process will be adjusted taking into account the wishes of our players.

We also want to implement a bot system during early access. This will allow players to enjoy the game even when they are palying alone

notes.title: eBall patch
notes.content:
Hi, dear eBallers 

We have released an update for eBall.

Patch notes:
- Eb2 reworked (Old Eb2 was replaced with new version of map)
- Eb4 reworked (Old Eb4 stayed in the game). Reworked version of map called Eb4v2
- Added new map Eb7.
- 20 achievements were added to the game.
- Small improvements in rocket and grenade damage calculation.
- Small improvements in Players stats table.

notes.title: Small patch
notes.content:
We uploaded small patch with few fixes and improvements.

-Rocket launcher fire, grenades, jumps attached to unity input system. 
Now you can change your binds in Unity launcher.

-Bug with closing in-match settings window in case your character died.

-Fixed some cases when bombs didn't explode.
